This weathered white wall-mounted coat rack features five metal hooks and is constructed from distressed wood. Measuring 24 by 4.5 inches, it has a 30-pound weight capacity and includes mounting hardware for installation in various rooms.

specs.compatible_items: Fishing waders, hunting waders, wader boots

record.description: This heavy-duty wader hanger is constructed from 1/4-inch stainless steel and features a chain design capable of supporting over 200 pounds. It allows for the storage and drying of fishing or hunting waders and boots off the ground to help maintain their shape and extend their service life.

specs.exterior: Bonded fleece with grid knit texture

record.description: This men's full-zip jacket is constructed from 100% polyester with a bonded fleece grid knit exterior and a sherpa fleece lining. It features two side zipper pockets, an embroidered logo on the front, and a label on the back.

These chocolate-colored pet stairs are made of blow-molded plastic with a removable carpet tread for easy cleaning. Designed for small, medium, and large dogs, the stairs feature a slight incline to help pets reach higher surfaces like beds or couches.

This Cross Tech3+ multifunction pen features a satin black lacquer finish with chrome accents. It includes a black ballpoint, a red ballpoint, a 0.5mm pencil, a stylus, and an eraser. The pen includes custom engraving and a lifetime mechanical warranty.

This black, short-sleeve t-shirt is made of 100% pre-shrunk cotton and features a screen-printed design. Produced in the USA, the garment is machine washable and available in size X-Large. It is a licensed product from Smack Apparel Inc.

specs.footbed: Soft EVA with anatomical arch support

record.description: These Reef boys' sandals feature a soft EVA footbed with anatomical arch support and a flexible Flex Triple Density EVA construction. The design includes a vegan leather upper strap with a jersey lining and a molded high-density EVA outsole for traction. They are sized for little kids in aqua and green.

This white Real Madrid home jersey for kids features a regular fit with a crewneck and short sleeves. Made from 100% recycled polyester doubleknit, it includes Climalite sweat-wicking fabric and mesh underarm inserts. The garment also features a woven team crest.
This Hyperkin HDTV cable connects all Saturn models to HDTVs. It supports 720p resolution for clear picture and audio. The set includes a 7-foot main cable and a 6-foot micro cable.

These polarized replacement lenses feature a dark silver mirror coating with 6% light transmission. Designed for Oakley Holbrook frames starting with OO9102 (55mm size), they are 1.4 mm thick and meet ANSI Z80.3 standards for UV protection and impact resistance. The package includes two lenses only.

These Bionica Nimah Poppy thong sandals feature fabric straps and a soft nubuck toe post. They include a quick-drying, molded EVA footbed with arch support, a shock-absorbing EVA midsole, and a flexible, slip-resistant rubber outsole designed for water and beach wear.

This heavyweight jumbo pet bowl is designed for extra-large breed dogs. It features a rubber bottom to prevent sliding on smooth surfaces and is dishwasher safe for easy cleaning. The product is available in various colors.

This officially licensed LEGO Batman poster measures 22.375" x 34" and is printed on FSC-certified gloss poster paper. The unframed artwork features high-resolution graphics and can be displayed using various mounting methods like clips, pins, or frames.

This three-pack of Carter's toddler tank tops features sleeveless designs in blue, orange, and gray. The shirts include ribbed necklines and pocket details. This set is sized 3T and comes in tagless packaging.

This pack contains 75 kraft corrugated double-wall boxes measuring 48" L x 40" W x 36" H. Designed for consolidating multiple shipments and protecting bulky or irregularly shaped items, these boxes are compatible with BGAYLORDLIDHD lids and ship flat in pallet quantities.

specs.features: USB charging port, headphone hole, anti-theft buckle

record.description: This black Seoky Rop sling bag is made of water-resistant PU leather with adjustable nylon straps. It features multiple compartments, an anti-theft buckle, a headphone hole, and an external USB charging port. Measuring 13.8 x 6.7 x 3.2 inches, it is designed for travel, sports, and daily use.

specs.subject: Grandmother and granddaughter
specs.cleaning_instructions: Dust with soft brush or cloth

record.description: This 5.5-inch hand-painted resin figure by artist Susan Lordi depicts a grandmother and granddaughter sitting on a gray bench. The cream-colored figures are holding hands and are suitable for display on shelves or tables. The piece comes in a fitted gift box with an enclosure card.

specs.features: Replaceable wire cutters, spring-action scissors, blade exchanger

record.description: The Leatherman Surge is a heavy-duty stainless steel multitool featuring 21 tools, including large pliers, spring-action scissors, and replaceable wire cutters. It includes a blade exchanger, one-hand opening capabilities, and a premium nylon sheath. This model comes with a 25-year warranty.

This white women's chef's coat features a double-breasted design with a ten-button closure that allows for reversible wear. The set includes a matching chef hat with a velcro fastener. This short-sleeved jacket is available in size small.

specs.features: Anti-slip palm, velcro wrist strap, blind stitched

record.description: These 3MM neoprene and nylon gloves provide thermal protection and a flexible fit for water sports like snorkeling, kayaking, and surfing. They feature a high-grip textured palm, a secure velcro wrist strap, and blind-stitched construction for durability. These gloves are available in multiple sizes for men, women, and children.

These denim shortalls for juniors feature a center front zipper, adjustable straps, and multiple pockets. They include a 3-inch cuffed inseam and are made with LYCRA for stretch. The garment is machine washable and tumble dry low.

specs.Compatibility: MacBook Pro, MacBook Air, Surface, Chromebook, Windows Laptop

record.description: This space gray aluminum USB-C hub features four USB 3.0 ports supporting data transfer speeds up to 5Gbps. It includes a 60W Power Delivery port for charging compatible laptops and accessories. The plug-and-play adapter is compatible with various MacBook models, Surface devices, and Chromebooks.
This official Alex Grey poster measures 18 inches by 24 inches. It is a museum-quality item featuring artwork that explores the connection between human and cosmic consciousness.

This ALPS Mountaineering low rocker features a powder-coated steel frame and breathable TechMesh fabric. It includes a foldable design with a shoulder bag for transport. The chair measures 22" W x 17" D x 31" H, weighs 11 lbs, and supports up to 300 lbs.

This pack of two size D batteries is an official accessory for the Good Guys doll from Child's Play 2. Produced by Trick Or Treat Studios and Universal Studios, these batteries are designed based on onscreen and behind-the-scenes details.
